name: LazyChat
author: lazychat AI

sections.description:
Connect your WooCommerce store to LazyChat — an AI sales agent built for social commerce. LazyChat replies to customers, takes orders, and closes sales across your social and messaging channels. This plugin keeps your store catalog, orders, and customer data in sync so LazyChat can answer product questions instantly, including image-based queries.

Developed by LazyChat

Why use this plugin?

  • Never miss a sale — LazyChat replies 24/7 while your WooCommerce catalog stays up to date
  • Real-time product sync — Products, variations, categories, and attributes stay synced with LazyChat
  • Order management — Create and update orders through LazyChat integration
  • Secure connection — Authenticated connection between your store and LazyChat

Plugin features

  • Automatic product synchronization with LazyChat
  • Order creation and management
  • Customer data integration
  • Coupon, category, and attribute management
  • Full WooCommerce product variation support
  • Optional debug logging for troubleshooting

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce required)
  2. Go to LazyChat → Settings in your WordPress admin
  3. Log in with your LazyChat account from app.lazychat.io
  4. Select your shop and click Sync to import your product catalog

Once connected, product changes in WooCommerce are sent to LazyChat automatically. LazyChat can then reply to social commerce conversations with accurate product details, prices, and options.

Sign up for LazyChat | Book a demo

External services

This plugin connects to LazyChat to sync your WooCommerce data and authenticate your store.

Service URL: https://app.lazychat.io

Data sent: Product catalog, order and customer data when managed via LazyChat, and basic site information needed to maintain the connection.

  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “LazyChat”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to LazyChat → Settings
  5. Log in with your LazyChat account (email and password from app.lazychat.io)
  6. Select your shop and click Sync to sync your products
sections.faq:
What is LazyChat?

LazyChat is an AI sales agent for social commerce. It replies to customer messages instantly, helps collect orders, and supports multilingual conversations. WooCommerce store owners use this plugin to keep product inventory synced with LazyChat.

Do I need a LazyChat account?

Yes. Sign up at app.lazychat.io or get.lazychat.io.

How do I connect my WooCommerce store?

Go to LazyChat → Settings, log in with your LazyChat email and password, select your shop, and click Sync. Your store connects to LazyChat automatically.

How do I connect my product inventory to LazyChat?

Install this plugin, log in under LazyChat → Settings, and run a product sync. After that, product updates in WooCommerce are reflected in LazyChat so your AI agent always has current prices, stock, and variations.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce product variations?

Yes. The plugin fully supports variable products, variations, attributes, and categories.

Which channels does LazyChat support?

LazyChat is built for social commerce — customer conversations on social media, messaging apps, and your website. This WooCommerce plugin supplies the product and order data LazyChat needs to reply accurately across those channels.

Does LazyChat support product image recognition?

Yes. LazyChat can recognize product images sent by customers and reply with the matching item, price, and options — as long as your WooCommerce catalog is synced via this plugin.

Is there a LazyChat mobile app?

Yes. LazyChat is available on the App Store and Google Play so you can manage chats and track orders on the go.
sections.changelog:
1.4.23

  • Product webhooks are delayed unique Action Scheduler jobs, so checkout and manual order creation are not blocked by the queue runner
  • REST API loopback check runs only on LazyChat settings screens (no longer stalls WooCommerce orders)
  • Webhook delivery failures in the background job are reported to LazyChat error logs

1.4.22

  • Improved product sync performance for busy stores
  • Added debug logging toggle (off by default) in plugin settings
  • Updated admin settings UI for WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.9
  • Updated plugin listing and description for social commerce

1.4.19

  • Improved README and plugin documentation
  • Updated installation instructions

1.4.16

  • Security improvements
  • Code quality enhancements

1.4.10

  • Bug fixes and optimizations

1.3.39

  • Stability improvements
